comment: Lighthouse gate thresholds for `npm run audit:lighthouse` (runs inside `npm run build`). Scores are simulated-mobile on localhost. RATCHET POLICY: baselines below are measured values minus run-to-run tolerance — never lower a number to make red green; only raise them as the site gets faster. a11y/BP/SEO/agentic stay at Google's green bands (90+) and fail the build on breach.
performance_baseline_note: BASELINE 2026-10-08: homepage measures 66/100 (LCP ~7.4s simulated, JS-driven hero). Deliberately set below measured to absorb variance. Raise toward 90 only via real perf work (defer three.js hero, preload LCP image, cut blocking JS) — not by editing this file down.
max_lcp_baseline_note: BASELINE 2026-10-08: homepage LCP ~7430ms simulated-mobile. Same root cause as performance baseline above; tighten toward 2500ms with the same perf work.
